title: The suppression thesis in Riemann's Habilitationsvortrag
summary: In 1854 Riemann presented his Habilitationsvortrag {\it Über die Hypothesen welche der Geometrie zu Grunde liegen} to the Faculty of Philosophy of the University of Göttingen. The lecture does not contain analytical developments and Riemann never explained the reason for this choice. According to Dedekind this choice was done in order to make the lecture understandable to the non-mathematician professors of the Faculty. This is the suppression thesis.
